parameters.content:
# One workflow, five independent paths
Import as a new INACTIVE workflow. Keep the three original workflows as rollback copies. Deactivate them before publishing this workflow.

Manual system check is read-only. The minute/hour triggers run separately, so a sync failure does not stop sending or intake. Dashboard sending still requires approval and explicit confirmation.

Gemini, Gmail, Sheets and CRM use your existing saved credentials. Gemini is the only AI provider.

# 1. Incoming customer email
Every five minutes: screen new messages, use Gemini, create a draft and publish the inquiry to the dashboard. AI failure becomes manual review; support replies are never auto-sent.

# 2. Form inquiries and follow-ups
Your original form address, validation and Sheets columns are preserved. Hourly follow-ups must also claim the current CRM lead before reserving Sheets or sending. A manual reply or unsaved change blocks that claim.

# 3. Save dashboard changes
Every minute: apply ordered lead/review updates to the same Sheet and eligible Gmail drafts. Initial capture only indexes the draft; it never sends or overwrites it.

# 4. Owner-confirmed sending
Every minute: claim one explicitly confirmed reply after its saved changes finish syncing. Preserve recipient/thread checks. A send is never retried automatically. An uncertain send stays on hold for review.
